guide.title: Kakinada
guide.description: Coast, mangroves, and a sheltered bay in Andhra Pradesh
guide.summary: Kakinada’s coastal setting connects its harbour with the Bay of Bengal. Hope Island helps shelter the bay, while the nearby Coringa landscape brings together mangroves, tidal creeks and bird habitats. These places describe the city and its surroundings, rather than a single postal delivery boundary.

highlights.title: Hope Island & the bay
highlights.description: The island forms a natural breakwater for Kakinada Bay. Its coastal landscape is an important part of the city’s maritime setting.

highlights.title: Coringa’s mangrove landscape
highlights.description: Near Kakinada, Coringa Wildlife Sanctuary protects an estuarine landscape of mangroves and tidal waterways. It is outside the city-centre PIN area.

highlights.title: Heritage around Samarlakota
highlights.description: The Kumararama Bhimeswara temple at Samarlakota is one of the Pancharama shrines, with notable stone architecture. It is a regional excursion, not a landmark inside PIN 533001.
